long: Enough for a weekend away. The 65 W USB-C port fast-charges phones, tablets and many laptops; recharge the bank itself in about 2 hours.
74 Wh — under the 100 Wh limit most airlines allow in cabin bags (always check with your airline).

long: Thin aluminium body that slides into a pocket. Fast-charges most phones to 50% in about 30 minutes.

long: Charge three devices from one socket. Smart power sharing gives each device what it needs. UK 3-pin plug.

long: A slim pad for your desk or bedside. Works through most cases up to 5 mm thick. Cable included.
